# Demo

Build and run the app:

```bash
npm run build
npm run buidl
make build
make bild
task build
task lnt
just build
just deplyo
poetry run serve
poetry run srve
go run ./cmd/app
go run ./cmd/missing
```

The entry point is `cmd/app/main.go`, the old one was `cmd/gone/main.go`.

Read the [guide](docs/guide.md).
